subject: Jessica Parks School Committee Campaign Platform
overview: School Committee candidate Jessica Parks discussed her background, motivations for running, and core campaign priorities, including expanding after-school care, supporting all learning levels, and improving district communication.

items.title: Introduction and Candidate Background
items.summary: Candidate Jessica Parks introduced herself as a Medford parent, MIT project manager, and urban planner running for the School Committee.

items.title: Favorite Medford Eateries
items.summary: Parks shared her favorite local dining spots, highlighting Colleen's ice cream shop as her top choice.

items.title: Motivation for Running
items.summary: Parks explained how working on the Invest in Medford override campaign and serving on an after-school task force inspired her to seek office.

items.title: Campaign Priorities
items.summary: Parks outlined her top campaign focuses, centering on expanding after-school care and supporting students across all learning and reading levels.

items.title: After-School Program Case Studies
items.summary: Parks described how the after-school task force researched models in neighboring communities to develop strategic recommendations for Medford.

items.title: Progress in After-School Programs
items.summary: Parks detailed recent improvements in local after-school program capacity, such as a new early pickup option and hiring a program consultant.

items.title: Teacher and Staff Collaboration
items.summary: Parks proposed holding regular coffee hours at individual schools to hear directly from teachers and principals about their needs.

items.title: School District Communication
items.summary: Parks emphasized the importance of establishing consistent, proactive communication to manage parent expectations and reduce administrative strain.

items.title: Upcoming Campaign Events
items.summary: Parks promoted her upcoming campaign meet-and-greets at Colleen's and the Great American Beer Hall, as well as her weekend canvassing schedule.
